Workflow.Name: Shell_PP_DesktopFlow_Template_Loader_Performer
Workflow.Definition:
"@@ConnectionString: ''
@@Type: 'Local'
@@DesktopType: 'local'
@@DisplayName: 'Local computer'
IMPORT 'controlRepo.appmask' AS appmask
IMPORT 'imageRepo.imgrepo' AS imgrepo
@SENSITIVE: [Enc_Dec_Key]
@INPUT ConfigData : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'ConfigData', 'Type': 'CustomObject', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': {{ }} } 
@INPUT Exception_EmailAddress : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Exception_EmailAddress', 'Type': 'String', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': 'murugan.marimuthu@shell.com' } 
@INPUT Run_LoaderFlow_Flag : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Run_LoaderFlow_Flag', 'Type': 'Bool', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': False } 
@INPUT Run_PerformerFlow_Flag : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Run_PerformerFlow_Flag', 'Type': 'Bool', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': False } 
@INPUT Run_ReportFlow_Flag : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Run_ReportFlow_Flag', 'Type': 'Bool', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': False } 
@INPUT Enc_Dec_Key : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Enc_Dec_Key', 'Type': 'String', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': '12345' } 
BLOCK 'Main Desktop Flow - Loader & Performer'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 SET SendExceptionEmail_Flag TO True
 CALL 'Global Error Handler'
END
 # ############### Desktop Flow Template - Loader & Performer ###############
 # ############### USECASE NAME ###############
 # USE CASE DESCRIPTION
 /# ############## Version: 1.0 - 02/2026 ##############
############## Author: Murugan ###############/
 # //////////////////////////// PROCESS NAME ////////////////////////////
 SET ProcessName TO $'''Usecase Name'''
 # ############### Initialize ###############
 SET ExceptionType TO $'''%''%'''
 SET ExceptionMessage TO $'''%''%'''
 SET SendExceptionEmail_Flag TO False
 SET Screenshot_Flag TO True
 # ####################### Get Computer name and User name #######################
 System.GetEnvironmentVariable.GetEnvironmentVariable Name: $'''USERNAME''' Value=> LoggedIn_UserName
 System.GetEnvironmentVariable.GetEnvironmentVariable Name: $'''COMPUTERNAME''' Value=> RobotID
 Text.Trim Text: LoggedIn_UserName TrimOption: Text.TrimOption.Both TrimmedText=> LoggedIn_UserName
 Text.Trim Text: RobotID TrimOption: Text.TrimOption.Both TrimmedText=> RobotID
 # ############### Close Applications ##################
 CALL 'Close All Applications'
 # ###############Read Config Temp Flow ##################
 CALL ReadConfig_Temp
 # ############# Config Exception #############
 IF IsEmpty(ConfigData) THEN
 SET Screenshot_Flag TO False
 SET ExceptionMessage TO $'''No data present in config object input'''
 SET SystemExceptionTo TO Exception_EmailAddress
 SET SystemExceptionCC TO Exception_EmailAddress
 SET Config_Email_Subject TO $'''%ProcessName% - Config Error'''
 SET EmailBody_SystemException TO $'''Config Data custom object is empty in %ProcessName% Main Desktop Flow'''
 Scripting.RunDotNetScript Language: System.DotNetActionLanguageType.CSharp Script: $'''throw new SystemException(\"%ExceptionMessage%\");'''
 END
 # ###############Assign values from config object##################
 CALL 'Assign Values from Config'
 # ############### Create Project Folders ##################
 CALL 'Create Project Folders'
 # //////////////////////////// Get Credential from Vault ////////////////////////////
 # //////////////////////////// Launch Application ////////////////////////////
 IF Run_LoaderFlow_Flag = True THEN
 CALL 'Add Items to Work Queue'
 END
 # ############### Process Work Queue Items ##################
 IF Run_PerformerFlow_Flag = True THEN
 SET Consecutive_Exception_Count TO 0
 SET Consecutive_Exception_Flag TO False
 CALL 'Process Work Queue Items'
 # ############### Email notification for consecutive exception ##################
 IF Consecutive_Exception_Flag = True THEN
 SET Email_To TO SystemExceptionTo
 SET Email_CC TO SystemExceptionCC
 SET Email_Body TO EmailBody_ConsecutiveException
 SET Email_Subject TO $'''%Config_Email_Subject% - Consecutive Exception'''
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionType>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionType ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionMessage>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionMessage ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 @@flowname: 'Shell_PP_SendEmail_Reusable_DesktopFlow'
External.RunFlow FlowId: 'a8bf1ac0-a1ed-4067-8434-82a3918b6d21' WaitToComplete: True @Email_Subject: Email_Subject @Email_Body: Email_Body @SystemException_Flag: True @BusinessException_Flag: False @Email_To: Email_To @Email_CC: Email_CC @SS_FilePath: $'''\"%ScreenShotFolderPath%\"''' @ReportFilePath: Bot_Working_Folder @Report_Flag: False @Out_ExceptionType=> Out_SendEmailExceptionType @Out_ExceptionMessage=> Out_SendEmailExceptionMessage
 END
 END
 # ############### Prepare Report and Send Email ###############
 IF Run_ReportFlow_Flag = True THEN
 CALL 'Prepare Queue Report'
 END
 # ############### Close Applications ##################
 CALL 'Close All Applications'
 # ############### Cleanup ##################
 CALL 'Cleanup Folders'
END
FUNCTION ReadConfig_Temp GLOBAL
 # ########### Read config file and create custom object ##############
 # ########### START ##############
 # ///////////////////////////// Change Input Values /////////////////////////////
 SET Config_FileName TO $'''C:\\Users\\INO827-F\\Downloads\\Shell_PP_FO_Trading_Oil_Config.xlsx'''
 SET Config_Sheet TO $'''Main'''
 # ########### Launch Excel and Read Data ##############
 Excel.LaunchExcel.LaunchAndOpenUnderExistingProcess Path: Config_FileName Visible: True ReadOnly: False UseMachineLocale: False Instance=> Config
 Excel.SetActiveWorksheet.ActivateWorksheetByName Instance: Config Name: Config_Sheet
 Excel.ReadFromExcel.ReadAllCells Instance: Config GetCellContentsMode: Excel.GetCellContentsMode.TypedValues FirstLineIsHeader: True RangeValue=> ConfigValuesData
 Excel.CloseExcel.Close Instance: Config
 # ########### Create Config Data custom Object ##############
 SET ConfigData TO {{ }}
 LOOP FOREACH CurrentItem IN ConfigValuesData
 SET CurrentKey TO CurrentItem[0]
 SET CurrentValue TO CurrentItem[1]
 SET ConfigData[CurrentKey] TO CurrentValue
 END
 # ########### END ##############
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Global Error Handler' GLOBAL
 # ############### Error handler ###############
 # ############### Capture Error Details ###############
 ERROR => LastError
 SET ExceptionType TO $'''System Exception'''
 SET ExceptionMessage TO $'''Error message :%LastError.Message% |
Flow name : %LastError.SubflowName% |
Action name :%LastError.ActionName%'''
 # ############### Capture Screenshot ###############
 IF Screenshot_Flag = True THEN
 DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDateTimeVal
 Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: CurrentDateTimeVal CustomFormat: $'''MMddyy_hhmmss''' Result=> ScreenShotTime
 Workstation.TakeScreenshot.TakeScreenshotAndSaveToFile File: $'''%ScreenshotFolderPath%\\%ScreenShotTime%.png''' ImageFormat: System.ImageFormat.Png
 ON ERROR

 END
 SET Screenshot_Flag TO False
 END
 # ############### Config Error ###############
 IF ConfigError = True THEN
 SET SystemExceptionTo TO Exception_EmailAddress
 SET SystemExceptionCC TO Exception_EmailAddress
 SET Config_Email_Subject TO $'''%ProcessName% - Config Error'''
 SET EmailBody_SystemException TO $'''Exception Message : %ExceptionMessage%'''
 END
 # ############### Send Email ###############
 IF SendExceptionEmail_Flag = True THEN
 SET Email_To TO SystemExceptionTo
 SET Email_CC TO SystemExceptionCC
 SET Email_Subject TO $'''%Config_Email_Subject% - %ExceptionType%'''
 SET Email_Body TO EmailBody_SystemException
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionType>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionType ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionMessage>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionMessage ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 @@flowname: 'Shell_PP_SendEmail_Reusable_DesktopFlow'
External.RunFlow FlowId: 'a8bf1ac0-a1ed-4067-8434-82a3918b6d21' WaitToComplete: True @Email_Subject: Email_Subject @Email_Body: Email_Body @SystemException_Flag: True @BusinessException_Flag: False @Email_To: Email_To @Email_CC: Email_CC @SS_FilePath: $'''\"%ScreenShotFolderPath%\"''' @ReportFilePath: Bot_Working_Folder @Report_Flag: False @Out_ExceptionType=> Out_SendEmailExceptionType @Out_ExceptionMessage=> Out_SendEmailExceptionMessage
 SET SendExceptionEmail_Flag TO False
 # ############### Close All Applications ###############
 CALL 'Close All Applications'
 # ############### Cleanup Folders ###############
 CALL 'Cleanup Folders'
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Assign Values from Config' GLOBAL
 BLOCK 'Assign values from config'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 SET Screenshot_Flag TO False
 SET ConfigError TO True
 CALL 'Global Error Handler'
 THROW ERROR
END
 # #################### Assign Values from Config Data Custom Object ####################
 SET PROD_Run TO ConfigData['PROD_Run']
 SET ProcessName TO ConfigData['ProcessName']
 SET WorkQueueID TO ConfigData['WorkQueueID']
 SET RootFolder TO ConfigData['RootFolder']
 Text.Replace Text: RootFolder TextToFind: $'''<<username>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: LoggedIn_UserName.Trimmed ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> RootFolder
 SET ProjectFolderName TO ConfigData['ProjectFolder']
 SET TempFolderName TO ConfigData['TempFolder']
 SET ScreenshotFolder TO ConfigData['ScreenshotFolder']
 SET Excel_ConnectionString TO ConfigData['Excel_ConnectionString']
 SET Business_EmailAddressTo TO ConfigData['Business_EmailAddressTo']
 SET Business_EmailAddressCC TO ConfigData['Business_EmailAddressCC']
 SET SystemExceptionTo TO ConfigData['SystemExceptionTo']
 SET SystemExceptionCC TO ConfigData['SystemExceptionCC']
 SET Config_Email_Subject TO ConfigData['Email_Subject']
 SET EmailBody_SystemException TO ConfigData['EmailBody_SystemException']
 SET EmailBody_BusinessException TO ConfigData['EmailBody_BusinessException']
 SET EmailBody_ConsecutiveException TO ConfigData['EmailBody_ConsecutiveException']
 SET EmailBody_Report TO ConfigData['EmailBody_Report']
 SET Delay_XS TO ConfigData['Delay_XS']
 Text.ToNumber Text: Delay_XS Number=> Delay_XS
 SET Delay_S TO ConfigData['Delay_S']
 Text.ToNumber Text: Delay_S Number=> Delay_S
 SET Delay_M TO ConfigData['Delay_M']
 Text.ToNumber Text: Delay_M Number=> Delay_M
 SET Delay_L TO ConfigData['Delay_L']
 Text.ToNumber Text: Delay_L Number=> Delay_L
 SET Delay_XL TO ConfigData['Delay_XL']
 Text.ToNumber Text: Delay_XL Number=> Delay_XL
 SET App_WaitTime TO ConfigData['App_WaitTime']
 Text.ToNumber Text: App_WaitTime Number=> App_WaitTime
 SET SecretName1 TO ConfigData['SecretName1']
 SET SecretName2 TO ConfigData['SecretName2']
 SET Consecutive_Exception_Limit TO ConfigData['Consecutive_Exception_Limit']
 Text.ToNumber Text: Consecutive_Exception_Limit Number=> Consecutive_Exception_Limit
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Process Work Queue Items' GLOBAL
 BLOCK 'Process Work Queue Items'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 CALL 'Global Error Handler'
 CALL 'Update Work Queue'
 REPEAT BLOCK
END
 # #################### Process Work Queue Items From PA Queue ####################
 @@'InputSummaryValue:WORKQUEUE': '%WorkQueueID%'
LOOP WHILE (WorkQueues.ProcessWorkQueueItem.ProcessWorkQueueItem WorkQueue: WorkQueueID WorkQueueItem=> WorkQueueItem)
 # ################# Initialize #################
 SET QueueJson TO $'''%''%'''
 SET Completed_Flag TO False
 # #################Consecutive exception limit validation#################
 IF Consecutive_Exception_Count >= Consecutive_Exception_Limit THEN
 SET ExceptionType TO $'''System Exception'''
 SET ExceptionMessage TO Current_ExceptionMessage
 SET Consecutive_Exception_Flag TO True
 EXIT FUNCTION
 END
 SET ExceptionType TO $'''%''%'''
 SET ExceptionMessage TO $'''%''%'''
 # ################# Assign values from Queue #################
 Cryptography.DecryptText.DecryptTextWithAES Encoding: Cryptography.EncryptionEncoding.Unicode TextToDecrypt: WorkQueueItem.Value DecryptionKey: Enc_Dec_Key Padding: Cryptography.PaddingMode.PKCS7 KeySize: Cryptography.AESKeySize.Bits256 DecryptedText=> Dec_QueueData
 Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: Dec_QueueData CustomObject=> WQJson_CO
 SET QueueNotes TO WorkQueueItem.ProcessingNotes
 # #################### Assign values from Queue Item ####################
 # //////////////////////////// Call Subflows to process work Item ////////////////////////////
 # //////////////////////////// GoTo Label to Update Work Item status ////////////////////////////
 GOTO 'Update Queue Item Status'
 # ################# Update Work Item Status #################
 # //////////////////////////// Set Completed Flag value True to update the work Item as Processed ////////////////////////////
 LABEL 'Update Queue Item Status'
 CALL 'Update Work Queue'
 END
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Update Work Queue' GLOBAL
 # //////////////////////////// Prepare Queue Output Json format ////////////////////////////
 SET QueueOutputJson TO $'''{
}'''
 Cryptography.EncryptText.EncryptTextWithAES Encoding: Cryptography.EncryptionEncoding.Unicode TextToEncrypt: QueueOutputJson EncryptionKey: Enc_Dec_Key PaddingMode: Cryptography.PaddingMode.PKCS7 KeySize: Cryptography.AESKeySize.Bits256 EncryptedText=> QueueOutputJson
 IF ExceptionMessage <> $'''%''%''' THEN
 SET Current_ExceptionMessage TO $'''%ExceptionType%-%ExceptionMessage%'''
 SET Completed_Flag TO False
 IF ExceptionType = $'''Business Exception''' THEN
 WorkQueues.UpdateWorkQueueItem.UpdateWithProcessingNotes WorkQueueItem: WorkQueueItem Status: WorkQueues.WorkQueueItemStatus.BusinessException InputValue: QueueOutputJson ProcessingResult: ExceptionMessage
 SET Email_To TO Business_EmailAddressTo
 SET Email_CC TO Business_EmailAddressCC
 SET Email_Body TO EmailBody_BusinessException
 SET Email_Subject TO $'''%Config_Email_Subject% - %ExceptionType%'''
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionType>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionType ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionMessage>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionMessage ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 @@flowname: 'Shell_PP_SendEmail_Reusable_DesktopFlow'
External.RunFlow FlowId: 'a8bf1ac0-a1ed-4067-8434-82a3918b6d21' WaitToComplete: True @Email_Subject: Email_Subject @Email_Body: Email_Body @SystemException_Flag: False @BusinessException_Flag: True @Email_To: Email_To @Email_CC: Email_CC @SS_FilePath: $'''\"%ScreenShotFolderPath%\"''' @ReportFilePath: Bot_Working_Folder @Report_Flag: False @Out_ExceptionType=> Out_SendEmailExceptionType @Out_ExceptionMessage=> Out_SendEmailExceptionMessage
 ELSE
 WorkQueues.UpdateWorkQueueItem.UpdateWithProcessingNotes WorkQueueItem: WorkQueueItem Status: WorkQueues.WorkQueueItemStatus.GenericException InputValue: QueueOutputJson ProcessingResult: ExceptionMessage
 SET Email_To TO SystemExceptionTo
 SET Email_CC TO SystemExceptionCC
 SET Email_Subject TO $'''%Config_Email_Subject% - %ExceptionType%'''
 SET Email_Body TO EmailBody_SystemException
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionType>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionType ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 Text.Replace Text: Email_Body TextToFind: $'''<<ExceptionMessage>>''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: ExceptionMessage ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> Email_Body
 @@flowname: 'Shell_PP_SendEmail_Reusable_DesktopFlow'
External.RunFlow FlowId: 'a8bf1ac0-a1ed-4067-8434-82a3918b6d21' WaitToComplete: True @Email_Subject: Email_Subject @Email_Body: Email_Body @SystemException_Flag: True @BusinessException_Flag: False @Email_To: Email_To @Email_CC: Email_CC @SS_FilePath: $'''\"%ScreenShotFolderPath%\"''' @ReportFilePath: Bot_Working_Folder @Report_Flag: False @Out_ExceptionType=> Out_SendEmailExceptionType @Out_ExceptionMessage=> Out_SendEmailExceptionMessage
 IF Current_ExceptionMessage = Previous_ExceptionMessage THEN
 Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: Consecutive_Exception_Count IncrementValue: 1
 ELSE
 SET Previous_ExceptionMessage TO Current_ExceptionMessage
 SET Consecutive_Exception_Count TO 0
 END
 END
 ELSE
 IF Completed_Flag = True THEN
 WorkQueues.UpdateWorkQueueItem.UpdateWithProcessingNotes WorkQueueItem: WorkQueueItem Status: WorkQueues.WorkQueueItemStatus.Processed InputValue: QueueOutputJson
 SET Previous_ExceptionMessage TO $'''%''%'''
 END
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Close All Applications' GLOBAL
 # ############### Close All Applications ##################
 # ############### KILL EXCEL ##################
 IF (System.IfProcess.ProcessIsRunning ProcessName: $'''EXCEL''') THEN
 Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''Stop-Process -Name \"EXCEL\" -Force''' ScriptOutput=> PowershellOutput
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
 # ############### KILL SAP ##################
 IF (System.IfProcess.ProcessIsRunning ProcessName: $'''saplogon''') THEN
 Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''Stop-Process -Name \"saplogon\" -Force''' ScriptOutput=> PowershellOutput
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
 # ############### KILL EDGE BROWSER ##################
 IF (System.IfProcess.ProcessIsRunning ProcessName: $'''msedge''') THEN
 Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''Stop-Process -Name \"msedge\" -Force''' ScriptOutput=> PowershellOutput
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Create Project Folders' GLOBAL
 BLOCK 'Create Project Folder'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 CALL 'Global Error Handler'
 THROW ERROR
END
 # ############### Close All Applications ##################
 # ############### Create project folder structutre based on the config value ###############
 SET ExceptionType TO $'''%''%'''
 SET ExceptionMessage TO $'''%''%'''
 IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.DoesNotExist Path: $'''%RootFolder%\\%ProjectFolderName%''') THEN
 Folder.Create FolderPath: RootFolder FolderName: ProjectFolderName Folder=> ProjectFolderPath
 ELSE
 SET ProjectFolderPath TO $'''%RootFolder%\\%ProjectFolderName%'''
 END
 IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.DoesNotExist Path: $'''%ProjectFolderPath%\\%TempFolderName%''') THEN
 Folder.Create FolderPath: ProjectFolderPath FolderName: TempFolderName Folder=> Bot_Working_Folder
 ELSE
 SET Bot_Working_Folder TO $'''%ProjectFolderPath%\\%TempFolderName%'''
 END
 IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.DoesNotExist Path: $'''%ProjectFolderPath%\\%ScreenshotFolder%''') THEN
 Folder.Create FolderPath: ProjectFolderPath FolderName: ScreenshotFolder Folder=> ScreenShotFolderPath
 ELSE
 SET ScreenShotFolderPath TO $'''%ProjectFolderPath%\\%ScreenshotFolder%'''
 END
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Cleanup Folders' GLOBAL
 # ############ Cleanup Project Folders ############
 # ############ Clear Bot working Folder ############
 # ############ Applicable only for Performer flow ############
 IF Run_PerformerFlow_Flag = True THEN
 IF IsNotEmpty(Bot_Working_Folder) THEN
 Folder.GetFiles Folder: Bot_Working_Folder FileFilter: $'''*''' IncludeSubfolders: False FailOnAccessDenied: True SortBy1: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending1: False SortBy2: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending2: False SortBy3: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending3: False Files=> TempFiles
 File.Delete Files: TempFiles
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
 # ############ Clear Screenshot Folder ############
 IF IsNotEmpty(ScreenShotFolderPath) THEN
 Folder.GetFiles Folder: ScreenshotFolderPath FileFilter: $'''*''' IncludeSubfolders: False FailOnAccessDenied: True SortBy1: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending1: False SortBy2: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending2: False SortBy3: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending3: False Files=> ScreenshotFiles
 File.Delete Files: ScreenshotFiles
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
 # ############ Delete Project Folder ############
 IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.Exists Path: ProjectFolderPath) THEN
 Folder.Delete Folder: ProjectFolderPath
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
 # ############ Clear config Data ############
 SET ConfigData TO {{ }}
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Prepare Queue Report' GLOBAL
 BLOCK 'Prepare Daily Report'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 CALL 'Global Error Handler'
 THROW ERROR
END
 # //////////////////////////// Input - Queue Report Name ////////////////////////////
 SET QueueReportName TO $'''Queue Report.xlsx'''
 /# ############ Get Work Queue Report based on completed on field. ############
############ Start Date - last month date and End Date - Current Date #############/
 DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateOnly CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDate
 # //////////////////////////// Change Duration ////////////////////////////
 DateTime.Add DateTime: CurrentDate TimeToAdd: -1 TimeUnit: DateTime.TimeUnit.Months ResultedDate=> QueueReport_StartDate
 DateTime.Add DateTime: CurrentDate TimeToAdd: 1 TimeUnit: DateTime.TimeUnit.Days ResultedDate=> QueueReport_EndDate
 Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: QueueReport_StartDate CustomFormat: $'''MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt''' Result=> QueueReport_StartDate_Formatted
 # //////////////////////////// Change Column Names in the Datatable ////////////////////////////
 # ############ Create new table for Queue Report ############
 Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { ^['Name', 'Start Time', 'End Time', 'Status'], [$'''''', $'''''', $'''''', $''''''] } DataTable=> QueueReport_DataTable
 Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: QueueReport_EndDate CustomFormat: $'''MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt''' Result=> QueueReport_EndDate_Formatted
 # ############ Filter work queue items based on completed on field ############
 # Maximum - 5000 records
 @@'InputSummaryValue:WORKQUEUE': '%WorkQueueID%'
WorkQueues.GetWorkQueueItems WorkQueue: WorkQueueID FilterRows: $'''<filter type=\"and\">
 <condition attribute=\"completedon\" operator=\"on-or-after\" value=\"%QueueReport_StartDate_Formatted%\" />
 <condition attribute=\"completedon\" operator=\"on-or-before\" value=\"%QueueReport_EndDate_Formatted%\" />
 </filter>


''' RowsToReturn: 5000 WorkQueueItems=> WorkQueueItems_Report
 # ############ Loop through each item and include only Unreported process notes related work queue item ############
 LOOP FOREACH CurrentWorkQueueItem IN WorkQueueItems_Report
 DISABLE Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: CurrentWorkQueueItem.Value CustomObject=> QueueReport_JsonAsCustomObject
 # //////////////////////////// Add Decryption if any values needed from Queue Item value ////////////////////////////
 # //////////////////////////// Update field name in the DataRow ////////////////////////////
 SET CurrentDataRow TO [CurrentWorkQueueItem.Name, CurrentWorkQueueItem.ProcessingStartTime, CurrentWorkQueueItem.CompletedOn, CurrentWorkQueueItem.StatusCode]
 Variables.AddRowToDataTable.AppendRowToDataTable DataTable: QueueReport_DataTable RowToAdd: CurrentDataRow
 END
 Variables.DeleteEmptyRowsFromDataTable DataTable: QueueReport_DataTable
 # ############ Write to Excel file based on Row count ############
 SET ReportFilePath TO $'''%Bot_Working_Folder%\\%QueueReportName%'''
 IF QueueReport_DataTable.RowsCount > 0 THEN
 # ############ Create New Excel and Write Data ############
 Excel.LaunchExcel.LaunchUnderExistingProcess Visible: True UseMachineLocale: False Instance=> QueueReport_Instance
 Excel.SaveExcel.SaveAs Instance: QueueReport_Instance DocumentFormat: Excel.ExcelFormat.OpenXmlWorkbook DocumentPath: ReportFilePath
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: QueueReport_Instance Value: QueueReport_DataTable.ColumnHeadersRow Column: 1 Row: 1
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: QueueReport_Instance Value: QueueReport_DataTable Column: 1 Row: 2
 Excel.CloseExcel.CloseAndSave Instance: QueueReport_Instance
 WAIT Delay_S
 # ############ Send Report Email ############
 SET Email_To TO Business_EmailAddressTo
 SET Email_CC TO Business_EmailAddressCC
 SET Email_Subject TO $'''%Config_Email_Subject% - Queue Report'''
 SET Email_Body TO EmailBody_Report
 @@flowname: 'Shell_PP_SendEmail_Reusable_DesktopFlow'
External.RunFlow FlowId: 'a8bf1ac0-a1ed-4067-8434-82a3918b6d21' WaitToComplete: True @Email_Subject: Email_Subject @Email_Body: Email_Body @SystemException_Flag: False @BusinessException_Flag: False @Email_To: Email_To @Email_CC: Email_CC @SS_FilePath: $'''\"%ScreenShotFolderPath%\"''' @ReportFilePath: ReportFilePath @Report_Flag: True @Out_ExceptionType=> Out_SendEmailExceptionType @Out_ExceptionMessage=> Out_SendEmailExceptionMessage
 END
 # ############ Delete Report File ############
 IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: ReportFilePath) THEN
 File.Delete Files: ReportFilePath
 ON ERROR

 END
 END
 END
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION 'Add Items to Work Queue' GLOBAL
 BLOCK 'Populate Work Queue'
ON BLOCK ERROR all
 CALL 'Global Error Handler'
 THROW ERROR
END
 # //////////////////////////// Replace Queue Input Data value with actual DataTable ////////////////////////////
 Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { } DataTable=> QueueInput_Data
 LOOP FOREACH CurrentValue IN QueueInput_Data
 # //////////////////////////// Queue Item 'Name' Column value ////////////////////////////
 SET Input_Value TO $'''%''%'''
 # ########## Check Item already exists in the Queue ##########
 @@'InputSummaryValue:WORKQUEUE': '%WorkQueueID%'
WorkQueues.GetWorkQueueItems WorkQueue: WorkQueueID FilterRows: $'''<filter type=\"and\">
 <condition attribute=\"name\" operator=\"eq\" value=\"%Input_Value%\" />
 <condition attribute=\"statuscode\" operator=\"eq\" value=\"0\" />
</filter>''' RowsToReturn: 5000 WorkQueueItems=> FilteredWQItems
 # //////////////////////////// Prepare Queue Input Json format from Data////////////////////////////
 SET QueueInputJson TO $'''{
}'''
 # ########## Add Item to Work Queue ##########
 IF FilteredWQItems.Count = 0 THEN
 Cryptography.EncryptText.EncryptTextWithAES Encoding: Cryptography.EncryptionEncoding.Unicode TextToEncrypt: QueueInputJson EncryptionKey: Enc_Dec_Key PaddingMode: Cryptography.PaddingMode.PKCS7 KeySize: Cryptography.AESKeySize.Bits256 EncryptedText=> Enc_QueueInput
 @@'InputSummaryValue:WORKQUEUE': '%WorkQueueID%'
WorkQueues.EnqueueWorkQueueItem.WithoutUniqueId WorkQueue: WorkQueueID Status: WorkQueues.WorkQueueItemEnqueueStatus.Queued Priority: WorkQueues.WorkQueueItemPriority.Normal Name: Input_Value Value: Enc_QueueInput ProcessingResult: $'''Fresh''' WorkQueueItem=> NewWorkQueueItem
 END
 END
 END
END FUNCTION

Workflow.Definition:
"@@ConnectionString: ''
@@Type: 'Local'
@@DesktopType: 'local'
@@DisplayName: 'Local computer'
IMPORT 'controlRepo.appmask' AS appmask
IMPORT 'imageRepo.imgrepo' AS imgrepo
@SENSITIVE: [SAP_Password, DEX_Password]
# ######################## Reusable Subflows ########################
/# ############## Version: 1.0 - 02/2026 ##############
############## Author: Murugan ###############/
# ############## Wait Time ##############
SET Delay_XS TO 1
SET Delay_S TO 2
SET Delay_M TO 5
SET Delay_L TO 10
SET Delay_XL TO 20
# ############## SAP LOGIN ##############
# ///////////////////////////// Input value for SAP login /////////////////////////////
SET SAPLogin_Status TO False
SET SAP_Cred_Error TO $'''Name or password is incorrect'''
SET SAP_Description TO $'''C94'''
SET SAP_ClientNo TO 110
SET SAP_Language TO $'''EN'''
SET SAP_Password TO $'''SAPPassword'''
SET SAP_UserName TO $'''SAPUserName'''
SET SAP_Child_Win TO $'''Initial window popup'''
SET SAP_Home_Win TO $'''SAP Easy Access'''
CALL 'SAP Login'
# ############## MAINFRAME LOGIN ##############
# ///////////////////////////// Input value for Mainframe login /////////////////////////////
SET DEX_Retry_Flag TO True

 System.TerminateProcess.TerminateProcessByName ProcessName: $'''hostex32'''
 ON ERROR

 END
 WAIT Delay_M
 END
 # ######### Launch DEX application #########
 System.RunApplication.RunApplicationAndWaitToLoad ApplicationPath: DEX_ApplicationPath WindowStyle: System.ProcessWindowStyle.Maximized Timeout: Delay_XL ProcessId=> AppProcessId WindowHandle=> DEX_WindowHandle
 WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindow.ToOpenByTitleClass Title: DEX_WindowTitle Class: $'''''' FocusWindow: True) FOR Delay_XL
 IF (UIAutomation.IfWindow.IsOpenByTitleClass Title: DEX_WindowTitle Class: $'''''') THEN
 # ######### Open Mainframe Session #########
 TerminalEmulation.OpenTerminalSession.OpenSession HllapiPath: DEX_DLLFilePath SessionName: DEX_SessionName Session=> TerminalSession
 WAIT Delay_S

 TerminalEmulation.SetTextOnTerminalSession.SetTextOnCursorPosition Session: TerminalSession Text: DEX_UserName TreatAtCharacterAsLiteral: False
 TerminalEmulation.MoveCursor Session: TerminalSession Row: 6 Column: 14

 TerminalEmulation.MoveCursor Session: TerminalSession Row: LoopIndex Column: 2
 WAIT Delay_XS
 TerminalEmulation.SendKey Session: TerminalSession ControlKey: TerminalEmulation.ControlKey.Transmit
 WAIT Delay_M
 EXIT LOOP
 END
 END
 TerminalEmulation.WaitForTextOnTerminalSession.WaitForTextOnScreen Session: TerminalSession Text: DEX_MainScreen IsRegEx: False Timeout: Delay_XL
 SET DEX_LoginStatus TO True
